stance_summary: Restrictive policy is already biting Canada harder than the 2027 CORRA strip admits. Overnight CORRA is 2.29 while the locked 2027 H-Z CRA average is 3.40, a +111bp re-hike cycle, even as August employment fell 42k, wages slowed to +2.0% y/y, and CPI-trim/median sit at 1.9/2.0 with headline only 3.0. The Fed's delivered 25bp hike and 3.85 SOFR raise the lag on Canadian demand; they do not create a domestic mandate for mid-3s CORRA. Receive the already-owned 2027 strip and HOLD it rather than open a duplicate.

trade.structure: Receive MX CRA 2027 H-Z as the locked CORRA family futures_strip_average of 2027-03/06/09/12 (CRAH27/CRAM27/CRAU27/CRAZ27). Canonical long duration: profits when the implied-rate mark falls. Packet strip mid 3.40 versus overnight CORRA 2.29.
trade.thesis: FACT: As of 2026-09-17 overnight CORRA is 2.29. Tradable CRA 3m implieds are 2.385 (2026-09), 2.775 (2026-12), 3.13 (2027-03, +84bp), 3.365 (2027-06, +107.5bp), 3.51 (2027-09, +122bp) and 3.595 (2027-12, +130.5bp); the equal-weight 2027 H-Z strip marks 3.40 (+111bp). FACT: August CPI headline is 3.0% y/y with CPI-trim 1.9 and CPI-median 2.0; employment -42k, unemployment 6.4% unchanged, average hourly wages +2.0% y/y versus +2.8% in July; CA gauges labor 38, consumer 45, inflation 55, activity 66. FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00; official SOFR jumped to 3.85 on 2026-09-17; SR3 prices 4.315 (2026-12), 4.565 (2027-03), 4.735 (2027-09). FACT: CA 2Y is 3.27 (1y percentile 97.8; 5y 58.5) and CA-US 2Y is -140bp (1y percentile 3.8). INFERENCE: The 2027 CRA strip is pricing an energy-pass-through catch-up hiking cycle that domestic labor and underlying CPI do not require. Restrictive US policy and the already-low 2.29 CORRA overnight should slow Canada further, so 2027 implied CORRA falls rather than being delivered into the mid-3s. UNKNOWN: whether BoC minutes' energy pass-through, Q2 GDP +0.8% q/q, and the two-sided oil news (shock absorbers weaker versus a Saudi/Oman workaround) can still force validation of the strip. CFTC/CME positioning is null/unavailable.
trade.mispricing: Market-implied 2027 CORRA of 3.13-3.595 (strip 3.40) requires roughly 3-5 additional 25bp BoC hikes from a 2.29 overnight while trim/median are already at target and jobs contracted. That hike cycle is the priced assumption; labor and underlying inflation say it is not delivered.

FACT: August Canadian CPI still holds headline at 3.0 with trim/median 1.9/2.0, and employment -42k with wages +2.0% y/y; the domestic mandate for mid-3s CORRA has not improved in this freeze.
FACT: CA 2Y is down 4bp over 5d while US 2Y is up 13bp, and CA-US 2Y is -140bp at the 3.8th 1y percentile; the front-end has started to diverge easier even as the 2027 strip still embeds +111bp.
Sidecar already owns LONG CORRA_2027H-Z pos-9849cf751c27 at packet mid 3.40; the discrepancy is live, so the debate trade stays the strip and the book action is HOLD, not a duplicate OPEN.

context_build.causal_mechanism: Restrictive policy bites with a lag. Canada is already at overnight CORRA 2.29 with a contracting labor market and underlying CPI at target; a 2027 implied path of 3.13-3.595 therefore requires a new inflation impulse (energy pass-through or imported Fed tightness) large enough to force 3-5 extra BoC hikes. The dove mechanism is that jobs and trim/median prevent that catch-up, so 2027 implied CORRA is marked too high and falls.
context_build.path_to_current_price: FACT: Over 1m CA 2Y is +31bp to 3.27 and CA 10Y +13bp to 3.83, while CA 2s10s flattened 18bp to 56bp (1y percentile 0.6). The tradable CRA curve still slopes from 2.29 overnight to 2.775 by Dec-26 and 3.40 on the 2027 H-Z strip. In the last 5d CA 2Y is -4bp versus US 2Y +13bp. US path: Fed hike 25bp to 3.75-4.00, SOFR 3.62 on 16 Sep then 3.85 on 17 Sep, US 2Y +57bp 1m to 4.76. USDCAD is 1.401 as of 2026-09-18 (+1.74% 1m, 74th 1y / 87th 5y percentile). The 2027 CRA strip is the residual of that 1m global-tightening rerating, not a new Canadian labor/CPI impulse.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: KNOWN: August Canadian CPI 3.0% with core/trim/median near 2%, employment -42k, BoC minutes flagging energy pass-through, and the Fed's well-telegraphed hike. NEW in this freeze relative to the last successful review is mainly the same data re-frozen as stale market-state (NZ_rates gap) plus the official SOFR 3.85 print after the hike. The 2027 CRA mid has not moved (strip still 3.40). A known core-at-target / jobs-down state is being used to justify a still-unprinted +111bp 2027 hike cycle via energy-pass-through talk and Fed/BoJ tightening, which is not a new Canadian transmission.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: CRA 2027 H-Z at 3.40 and CRAZ27 at 3.595 require the BoC to deliver roughly 111-130bp of hikes from 2.29 into 2027, i.e. a completed re-tightening cycle to the mid-3s, because energy pass-through and global tightening supposedly overwhelm trim/median at 1.9/2.0 and a 38 labor gauge.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: Disagree that energy pass-through and the Fed's delivered hike are sufficient to validate 2027 implied CORRA in the mid-3s. Underlying CPI is already at target and employment contracted; the priced catch-up hike cycle will not be delivered, so the strip mark falls.
context_build.price_decomposition: Level: overnight CORRA 2.29 versus 2027 H-Z strip 3.40 is +111bp of path, of which Dec-26 1m COAZ26 is only +29bp to 2.58 and Dec-26 3m CRAZ26 is +48.5bp to 2.775; the bulk of the hike (+84 to +130.5bp) sits in 2027 H-Z contracts. Change: 1m sovereign CA 2Y +31bp and 2s10s -18bp show the front-end already rerated higher, while the last 5d (-4bp on CA 2Y) is a modest fade. Marginal driver is 2027 policy-path hike odds, not 10Y term premium (CA 10Y 3.83, CA-US 10Y -111bp). US SR3 peak 4.735 in Sep-27 is a separate, hotter labor (75) story and should not be copy-pasted onto Canada.

historical_reference.distribution: CA 2Y 3.27 is the 97.8th 1y percentile but only the 58.5th 5y percentile; CA 5Y 3.54 is 97.8th 1y / 81.8th 5y; CA 10Y 3.83 is 97.4th 1y / 96.8th 5y. CA 2s10s 56bp is the 0.6th 1y percentile (5y 65.6th). CA-US 2Y -140bp is the 3.8th 1y / 4.3rd 5y percentile. Those 1y extremes are discovery flags that a 2027 re-hike from 2.29 with trim/median at target is unusual inside the packet window, not a self-contained mean-reversion signal.
analogs: No complete dated analog with a measured forward outcome is supplied in this freeze. The packet's own 1y extremes (CA 2s10s 0.6th percentile; CA-US 2Y 3.8th percentile) plus the live policy path (2.29 overnight versus 3.40 2027 strip) are the historical reference; they flag an unusual priced re-hike rather than a named episode to copy.
historical_reference.regime_differences: This freeze has a two-sided oil narrative (energy-market shock absorbers weaker versus a Saudi/Oman workaround), a just-delivered Fed 25bp hike with SOFR 3.85, BoJ at 1.25%, and Canadian core already at target. Unlike a classic mid-cycle hike from a hot labor market, CA labor is 38 with -42k jobs. Q2 GDP +0.8% q/q is the main regime offset. NZ rates are unavailable and CFTC is null, so cross-country analog quality is truncated.

The selected 2027 H-Z strip is the segment where the disallowed Canadian re-hike is actually priced.

two_year.rationale: CA 2Y 3.27 as of 2026-09-17 is the 97.8th 1y percentile and already embeds most of the re-hike, so receiving it is a valid dove expression. It is inferior to CRA 2027 because the 2Y mixes term premium with policy, CA_official_curve is unavailable, and the tradable CORRA path is the actual priced hike sequence.

five_year.rationale: CA 5Y 3.54 (97.8th 1y / 81.8th 5y) moved +25bp 1m / -9bp 5d. It dilutes the 2027 policy discrepancy with term premium and global duration beta. CA_official_curve is unavailable. Not the cleanest dove expression versus the CRA strip.

ten_year.rationale: CA 10Y 3.83 (97.4th 1y / 96.8th 5y) is a global long-end co-move with US 10Y 5.01 (99.9th 5y). A 10Y receive would own Treasury beta more than BoC path error. Not selected.

curve.rationale: CA 2s10s 56bp is the 0.6th 1y percentile after -18bp 1m, so a steepener would pay if the 2027 hike is cancelled and the front rallies. CA_official_curve is unavailable, and a steepener still leaves residual 10Y global beta. Outright 2027 CRA owns more of the path error than a curve overlay.

cross_market_rv.rationale: CA-US 2Y -140bp as of 2026-09-17 is the 3.8th 1y / 4.3rd 5y percentile. A dove who thinks Canada stays easier would want the spread more negative (long the RV under the mark-falls convention). Inferior to outright CORRA because a global easing impulse would also lower US 2Y 4.76 and compress the spread, and the US labor gauge is 75 after a delivered hike.
